other_conditions: Applicant must have secured 60% or more marks in the 12th standard.

Applicant must be undergoing training in a recognized or selected coaching institution for recruitment examinations conducted in UPSC, GPSC Class-1, Class-2, Class-3, Subordinate Services Selection Board, Panchayat Services Selection Board, and Government of India Railways, Banks etc.
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of up to ₹20,000 per student or the actual fee payable, whichever is lower.
